messages:
kevin_astrum: Hey team — Astrum Logistics. We have a pilot next week and need help onboarding a custom NER model to extract airway bill IDs, HS codes, and limited PII (names on manifests). Must be private (VPC) with KMS/HSM and no logs stored longer than 7 days. Can CS kick this off?

maria_cs: Thanks Kevin — we can run this. Quick Qs: is the model you want us to host an internal HF model or a vendor artifact? Also any mandatory compliance docs?

kevin_astrum: It’s an internal fine-tuned Llama 13B exported to HF format. We have a SOC2 addendum and a short DPA. We need end-to-end encryption and HSM for keys. Also need an eval that shows >0.92 F1 for airway bill IDs.

juan_ml: Hey — quick ask from ML: can you share 500 labeled examples (train/dev/test split) + examples of OCR noise? We’ll run a baseline on Redwood-hosted dedicated infra. Also: what inference latency SLO do you need?

kevin_astrum: Sending examples now via secure upload link. Latency: <=120ms median for single-record queries. Batch throughput not critical for pilot.

maria_cs: Got it. I’ll create an intake ticket and loop in eng-ml + security. Ops note: private deployment path is needed for HSM.

opsbot: Ticket CS-10294 created: Private on-board request for Astrum Logistics (model: llama-13b-custom). Assigned to eng-ml. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/CS-10294

lisa_cs_manager: Heads-up — Astrum is in renewal Q2 and flagged as at-risk if pilot slips. This has priority.

juan_ml: Thanks. For the eval, we’ll use exact-match and regex-augmented metrics for airway IDs, plus entity-level F1 for HS codes. Proposed acceptance: airway ID F1 >= 0.92, HS code accuracy >= 0.9. Any objections?
kevin_astrum: Those thresholds are fine. One more: can Redwood run a privacy-preserving leakage test (sample-based) before we go live?

tara_policy: From security/policy: yes, we require a targeted data-leakage scan and prompt-injection simulation. Also confirm that no customer data will be exported to external telemetry. We’ll need the DPA + SOC2 on file before enabling logs.

maria_cs: Noted. Kevin — please upload DPA/SOC2 to the secure portal. We’ll block logs until posted.

kevin_astrum: Uploaded DPA and SOC2 to the portal (link DM’ed to Maria).

juan_ml: I’ll stage a dedicated pool with quantization profile Q4_0 and run a 500-sample eval. Shortcut command we’ll run: ```redwood eval run --model "astrum/llama-13b-finetuned" --dataset s3://astrum-secure/evals/ner-500.jsonl --tasks ner --metrics entity_f1,exact_match --private```. Will report back with results by EOD tomorrow.

maria_cs: Great. Timeline recap: intake ticket CS-10294 created, security checks pending DPA, eval by eng-ml EOD tomorrow, ops to prep VPC + HSM. If all green, can we do a canary deploy mid-next-week?

opsbot: Note: VPC allocation request initiated (VPC-7892). HSM provisioning ETA 48-72 hrs.

tara_policy: Also scheduling a 30-min risk call tomorrow 10:30am to approve leakage test scope. Invite sent.

kevin_astrum: Thanks all — we’ll be on the risk call. Pilot success is critical for our renewal decision, appreciate the priority.

lisa_cs_manager: Noted. CS will provide weekly status to Astrum execs during pilot. Please flag any blockers ASAP so we can escalate.

juan_ml: FYI if eval passes but latency is high we can try a trimmed KV-cache or smaller variant. Will include perf profiling in the results.

maria_cs: Copy. Closing loop: next steps for everyone: kevin upload docs (done), tara run policy checks, juan run eval, ops complete VPC/HSM. Update ticket CS-10294 with eval + perf artifacts.

kevin_astrum: Will do. Thanks! :thumbsup:
